verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email SaaS, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents only the JMAP API, API tokens and OAuth/Bearer auth. These are developer building blocks an agent integration could be built on, not a first-party MCP server, and nothing in the pack mentions MCP at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
